verdicts.reason: A opens with a four-line legal block at top-left that is as prominent as the copy beside it, and the CTA is squeezed beneath that legal text, away from the headline, so the reading order goes legal → headline → button. The GLACIER wordmark also sits under the headline and the can is a tiny afterthought on the right. B reads better left to right (can → headline → CTA), with the legal text moved to the right edge, but it shares the same flaws: the legal block is oversized and wraps into a cramped column that competes with the CTA, the wordmark is demoted below the headline, the can is too small to read, and the decorative circles are cut off at the corners.
